Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To both parties: the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable. This is a refund on the clock, not a finding that the driver acted in bad faith.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.50 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

What each side argued

Rider advocate8 claim(s), 8 kept

  1. The effective in-geofence dwell on this trip is 179 seconds against a free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip, so the fee is not chargeable and the whole contested $4.50 cancellation-fee line is refunded to the rider in full, with no driver compensation.

    Read the whole claim

    The driver's qualifying run runs from 18:33:47 to 18:36:46 across 19 qualifying fixes, a measured dwell of 179 seconds, and trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec fixes the required minimum at 180 seconds; the shortfall in the trace's own computation is 1.0 second.

    EV-GPS-02741, EV-TRIP-02741, EV-FARE-02741 · POL-NS-06

  2. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and limb (c) fails.

    Read the whole claim

    Limb (c) requires the driver to hold position inside the geofence for a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' event. Here the first qualifying fix is at 18:33:47 (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0) and the trip was terminated at 18:36:46, giving 179 seconds against the required 180. The rider wins by breaking that single limb, and the anchor clause itself then sends the refund to POL-NS-06.

    EV-GPS-02741, EV-TRIP-02741 · POL-NS-01

  3. Limb (d) fails on the same clock: the trip had to be terminated at or after the moment the required 180 second dwell elapsed, that is at or after 18:36:47, and it was terminated at 18:36:46.

    Read the whole claim

    The platform's own telemetry corroborates the shortfall independently of the GPS export - the free waiting period was started at 18:33:49 and the driver cancelled at 18:36:46, 177 seconds later - which is inconsistent with the driver's statement that he waited the free period before cancelling.

    EV-TRIP-02741, EV-GPS-02741 · POL-NS-01

  4. The driver cannot extend the clock by accumulating dwell across intervals.

    Read the whole claim

    EV-ADVIS-02741-01 is MISSING with admissibility weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that impairment: no traffic advisory covers this pickup road in this window. POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present and populated advisory of an admissible type covers the pickup road and the waiting period, so limb (i) is unavailable, the trace shows a single in-geofence interval, and the 179 second interval is the whole of the effective dwell.

    EV-ADVIS-02741-01, EV-GPS-02741 · POL-NS-06

  5. No recomputation under POL-NS-05 can rescue the fee either.

    Read the whole claim

    If the arrival marker were treated as false and the waiting clock recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, that fix is at 18:33:47 - the very timestamp of the 'I'm Here' tap, with dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0 - so there is no earlier in-geofence fix from which a longer clock could run. The dwell is 179 seconds on the arrival-event reading and 179 seconds on the recomputed reading, and the shortfall stands either way.

    EV-GPS-02741, EV-TRIP-02741 · POL-NS-05, POL-NS-01

  6. The driver's payout under POL-NS-07 never arises on these facts.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-NS-07 compensates at 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-06 both withholds the fee and states expressly that no driver compensation is payable, so the driver_compensation figure of $3.60 carried in the fare derivation is not payable and the rider funds nothing.

    EV-FARE-02741, EV-GPS-02741 · POL-NS-07, POL-NS-06

  7. This case can be decided on the money and does not require human review.

    Read the whole claim

    The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check needs both driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d at 4 or more and a rate above 0.08 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d; the record shows 1 termination against 62 completed trips, a rate of 0.016, so neither limb is met and no escalation follows from it. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d)'s abuse trigger does not fire, and the rider is entitled to the refund on the record as it stands rather than to a held fee.

    EV-DPROF-02741, EV-RPROF-02741 · POL-NS-07, POL-NS-09

  8. The artifacts carrying the deciding facts are unimpaired: the GPS trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown are each COMPLETE with no issues and weight_multiplier 1.0, and the trace has 100 percent coverage at a 10 second cadence with no gaps across the waiting window.

    Read the whole claim

    None of POL-NS-08's limbs (a) to (d) fires on the arrival, dwell or fare records, so no discount under POL-GEN-02 lowers confidence in the refund and the confidence floor for escalation is not approached.

    EV-GPS-02741, EV-TRIP-02741, EV-FARE-02741 · POL-GEN-02, POL-NS-08
Driver advocate11 claim(s), 11 kept

  1. The driver arrived at the pickup point.

    Read the whole claim

    The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 18:33:47, 9 minutes 45 seconds after the match at 18:24:02, and the trace's arrival block records 19 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this pickup. POL-NS-01 limb (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are therefore both met, on a trace that is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 100.0% coverage and no residual issue codes.

    EV-TRIP-02741, EV-GPS-02741 · POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

  2. The driver's in-geofence hold is one continuous interval, not a leave-and-return.

    Read the whole claim

    The arrival block reports run_count 1 and a single qualifying run of 19 fixes spanning 18:33:47 to 18:36:46, the trace holds no sampling gap at all (gaps [], max_gap_sec 0.0, coverage_pct 100.0), and no excursion beyond the radius is recorded. There is nothing in the export to suggest the driver left the pickup and came back.

    EV-GPS-02741, EV-TRIP-02741 · POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

  3. The waiting period was served.

    Read the whole claim

    The arrival block measures the longest qualifying run at 179.0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force for this trip, a difference of 1.0 s - one tenth of the trace's own sampling interval (sample_interval_sec 10.0, expected_interval_sec 10.0). An export sampled every ten seconds cannot resolve a one-second boundary: on every sample from 18:33:47 to 18:36:46 the driver is in position inside the radius, and the record does not establish that he terminated the trip before the wait the fee was charged for had run. I do not contend the derived figure is anything other than 179.0 s; I contend a 1.0 s margin below the sampling resolution is not proof of a shortfall, and the driver's admitted presence at every sampled instant should not be defeated by it.

    EV-GPS-02741, EV-TRIP-02741 · POL-NS-01, POL-NS-06

  4. POL-NS-03 does not apply on these facts.

    Read the whole claim

    That clause governs a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin; here the stationary fixes are inside the 50 m STANDARD radius itself (qualifying_fix_count 19, run_count 1), so this is not a wrong-entrance or wrong-block case and the 50 percent pin-ambiguity goodwill provision is not in play.

    EV-GPS-02741, EV-TRIP-02741 · POL-NS-03, POL-NS-02

  5. No false-arrival finding arises under POL-NS-05.

    Read the whole claim

    The arrival block places the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:33:47, the same instant as the 'arrived' event (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so the trace does not put the driver away from the pin or in motion when the marker was pressed; the waiting clock is not recomputed and no false-arrival referral is engaged.

    EV-GPS-02741, EV-TRIP-02741 · POL-NS-05, POL-NS-02

  6. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider; it fails on two independent limbs.

    Read the whole claim

    The chat log holds exactly one message, sent by the driver at 18:34:07 ('im at the pickup point') and read by the rider at 18:34:37, and the rider sent nothing during the waiting window, so limb (a) is not met and no locating or coordinating message of the rider's exists to trigger the clause. Separately, the rider track's 48 fixes all lie between 616.9 m and 622.3 m from the pin (mean 619.4 m) with rider_qualifying_fix_count 0, so limb (c)'s 100 m presence test is affirmatively FAILED on admissible fixes - this is not the 'undecidable' case that limb (c) treats as neutral.

    EV-CHAT-02741, EV-GPS-02741, EV-TRIP-02741 · POL-NS-04

  7. The rider was not at the pickup point and never appeared.

    Read the whole claim

    No boarding event is recorded anywhere in the trip record, the driver's single message was read and left unanswered, the rider's own device never came within 600 m of the pin, and the trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises. The rider's assertion that the driver 'cancelled almost immediately' is not supported: the cancellation came 12 minutes 44 seconds after the match and only after a documented in-geofence wait.

    EV-GPS-02741, EV-TRIP-02741, EV-CHAT-02741 · POL-NS-01

  8. EV-ADVIS-02741-01 is MISSING - no advisory covers Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd in this window - and it carries weight 0.0 with the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT.

    Read the whole claim

    That absence is decisive against any accumulation argument: POL-NS-06(i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated, and there is none, so no separate in-geofence intervals may be summed and no part of the wait can be excused. The single-interval dwell record is the whole of the evidence on the clock.

    EV-ADVIS-02741-01, EV-GPS-02741 · POL-NS-06

  9. The sum charged is the platform's own figure, not a number the driver or the pipeline invented.

    Read the whole claim

    fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee and total_charged are SGD 4.50, exactly platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd for this STANDARD-class RYDE_X trip, and payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. There is accordingly no fare-integrity defect of the kind POL-NS-08(d) describes.

    EV-FARE-02741, EV-TRIP-02741 · POL-NS-01, POL-NS-08

  10. If POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and nothing in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee, being SGD 3.60.

    Read the whole claim

    The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4-or-more limb, and 1 over driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 62 is 0.016, below 0.08, so BOTH limbs of that conjunctive check fail and compensation is payable. No other profile field is relied on for this test.

    EV-FARE-02741, EV-DPROF-02741 · POL-NS-07

  11. This is a rider-filed dispute over a charge the platform has already made and not refunded.

    Read the whole claim

    Under POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION is party-relative: leaving the present state untouched leaves the SGD 4.50 standing against the rider, which is the outcome the driver seeks on the fee; and where POL-NS-07 compensation is payable the outcome the case produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring the SGD 3.60 payout rather than a refund to the filing party.

    EV-FARE-02741, EV-DPROF-02741 · POL-GEN-03, POL-NS-07

Draft 1 - sampled
To both parties: the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable. This is a refund on the clock, not a finding that the driver acted in bad faith. The driver did arrive, and I accept that. The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 18:33:47, 9m45s after the 18:24:02 match, and the GPS trace's arrival block records 19 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 18:33:47 (run_count 1, no excursions, gaps [] and max_gap_sec 0.0). POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are therefore met, on a trace that is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 100% coverage. The driver's claims that POL-NS-03 does not apply (his stationary fixes lie inside the radius, not outside it) and that POL-NS-05 raises no false-arrival finding (the first qualifying in-geofence fix coincides with the 'I'm Here' tap, dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0, so there is no recomputed clock and no false-arrival referral) are accepted. The fee nonetheless fails on the waiting period. POL-NS-01(c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least the free waiting period in force, which is trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180 s. The platform's own derived measurement gives the single qualifying run as 179.0 s, from the first qualifying fix at 18:33:47 to the termination at 18:36:46, a shortfall of 1.0 s (derived.arrival.shortfall_sec 1.0). The platform's wait-timer events corroborate independently: the free waiting period started at 18:33:49 and the trip was cancelled at 18:36:46, 177 s later. POL-NS-01(d) likewise requires termination at or after the dwell elapsed (18:36:47); the trip was terminated at 18:36:46. POL-NS-06 is drafted as strict liability: where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the free waiting period, the fee 'is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. I have considered and rejected the driver's argument that a 1.0 s margin below the trace's 10 s sampling interval is not proof of a shortfall. The policy provides no de minimis allowance and does not read the shortfall down to the sampling cadence; the governing measurement is the platform's own derived figure of 179.0 s, and the platform's wait-timer events (177 s) agree in direction. POL-NS-12 cannot assist the driver, because it applies only where trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO; here it is BUTTON, so limbs (b) and (c) are decided on the exported trace. The rider's absence is accepted as fact: no boarding event is recorded, the only chat message is the driver's at 18:34:07 ('im at the pickup point', read 18:34:37), the rider sent nothing in the waiting window, and the rider's track never came within 600 m of the pin (mean 619.4 m, rider_qualifying_fix_count 0). The rider's assertion that the driver 'cancelled almost immediately' is not supported - the cancellation came 12m44s after the match and after a documented in-geofence wait. But the refund does not depend on the rider's presence; it follows from the shortfall itself. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider either (limb (a) needs a rider message and there is none), and the refund issues under POL-NS-06 and not under POL-NS-04. The missing advisory EV-ADVIS-02741-01 (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so no traffic_advisory is present or populated) makes POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals unavailable, but that is moot: the trace shows one in-geofence interval, so there is nothing to sum in any event. No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 compensates at 80% of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-06 both withholds the fee and expressly states that no compensation is payable, so the SGD 3.60 figure carried in the fare derivation is not paid, and the driver's claim that this is a DRIVER_COMPENSATION case with amount_sgd mirroring that payout is rejected. The anti-farming check does not trip - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 62, a rate of 0.016, failing both limbs of that conjunctive test - so no escalation follows from it. No escalation arises at all. Every artifact is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so no POL-NS-08(a) to (d) impairment engages and no finding is discounted under POL-GEN-02; there is no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts on arrival, dwell or rider presence; disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides; and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0. Refund: SGD 4.50, read from fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee and total_charged (both SGD 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), equal to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd and reconciling with it, so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect exists. amount_sgd is the refund to the filing party; driver_compensation_sgd is null. The monetary effect (SGD 4.50) does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold (SGD 8.00), so the refund executes automatically. No clause produces a referral on these facts: the arrival marker is not false (POL-NS-05(ii)), the anti-farming check does not trip (POL-NS-07), and the reason code carried is RIDER_NO_SHOW, the rider's failure to appear, so POL-NS-01's driver-education referral for a code other than the rider's non-appearance is not engaged.
Draft 2 - sampled
Rider — you get the full $4.50 cancellation fee back. Driver — the fee is not chargeable, because the waiting period it pays for was never completed. What the record shows. The trip matched at 18:24:02. You tapped 'I'm Here' at 18:33:47 and the platform's free-wait timer started at 18:33:49; you cancelled at 18:36:46 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02741, COMPLETE, weight 1.0, 100% coverage, no gaps, 10 s cadence) puts you inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 18:33:47 and holds you there as one continuous qualifying run of 19 fixes (no leave-and-return, run_count 1) ending at 18:36:46 — a measured dwell of 179 seconds. POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the arrival tap, and the free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). 179 s is 1 second short of 180 s, so limb (c) fails; limb (d) fails with it, because the trip ended at 18:36:46, one second before the required dwell elapsed at 18:36:47. These are the record's own derived values and I do not recompute them. I have considered the driver's argument that a 1-second margin lies below the trace's 10-second sampling interval and so cannot prove a shortfall. I reject it. POL-NS-06 is a strict waiting-period rule, the trace is not impaired under any limb of POL-NS-08 (no sampling gap, full coverage, rider_track present, farewell reconciled), and the shortfall is corroborated independently by the platform's own telemetry — the wait timer ran 18:33:49 to 18:36:46, 177 seconds. No discount under POL-GEN-02 applies. On the fee. Because limb (c) fails, POL-NS-01 does not make the fee chargeable, and the refund is fixed by POL-NS-06: the fee is refunded to the rider in full and no driver compensation is payable. The $3.60 figure in the fare derivation under POL-NS-07 (80% of $4.50) is therefore not paid — POL-NS-06 displaces POL-NS-07 — and the driver's claims for NO_ACTION / DRIVER_COMPENSATION fail. The fare line itself is sound: $4.50 equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. The driver's factual account is partly right and does not change the result. The rider's own device never came within 600 m of the pin (rider track 616.9–622.3 m, 0 qualifying fixes inside the 100 m presence radius), the driver's message at 18:34:07 was read at 18:34:37 and left unanswered, and there was no boarding event. But POL-NS-06 refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded, so the rider's absence cannot save the charge. The rider's assertion that the driver 'cancelled almost immediately' is not supported — the cancellation came 12 minutes 44 seconds after the match — but the fee still fails on the clock. Clauses that do not apply. POL-NS-03 is not engaged: your stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius, not outside it but within 400 m, so there is no wrong-entrance case and no pin-ambiguity goodwill. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the rider sent no locating or coordinating message, so limb (a) fails, and limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes rather than undecidable. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the arrival marker was true (first in-geofence fix at 18:33:47, dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0, driver stationary), so no false-arrival item arises and none is referred. No referral is made: the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW is one POL-NS-01(d) recognises, so there is no mis-selected-code driver-education item either. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02741-01, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) only makes POL-NS-06(i) accumulation unavailable; it carries no fact and impairs nothing. Execution. The refund of $4.50 is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00, so it executes automatically on issue. This ruling was made without human review, and either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
Draft 3 - sampled
To the rider and the driver: this dispute is over the $4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02741 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The fee is refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable. Arrival is established and is not in dispute. The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' tap at 18:33:47, and the GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from that same instant — dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0, 19 qualifying in-geofence fixes in one continuous run from 18:33:47 to 18:36:46, run_count 1, no gaps and 100% coverage. POL-NS-01 limb (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are met, and POL-NS-03 does not apply: that clause governs a driver stationary OUTSIDE the arrival radius but within 400 m, and this driver was inside the radius. No false-arrival finding arises under POL-NS-05 either, because the arrival tap coincides with the first qualifying fix, so the waiting clock is not recomputed and no POL-NS-05(ii) referral is made. The fee nevertheless fails on the clock, because POL-NS-01 is conjunctive. Limb (c) requires the driver to hold position inside the geofence for a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force — 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec. The trace's own derived arrival block measures the in-geofence dwell at 179.0 seconds (first qualifying fix 18:33:47, last 18:36:46), a shortfall of 1.0 second, and the platform's telemetry independently agrees: the free-wait timer started at 18:33:49 and the driver cancelled at 18:36:46, three seconds before the 180-second period would have run out. Limb (d) fails on the same arithmetic, the trip having been terminated before the required dwell elapsed. The driver's principal answer — that a 1.0-second margin lies below the trace's 10-second sampling interval (sample_interval_sec 10.0) and so cannot prove a shortfall — is rejected. POL-NS-06 is deliberately drafted as strict liability: a dwell shorter than the free waiting period makes the fee non-chargeable and refunds it in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded. The 179.0 s figure is the record's own measurement, on a COMPLETE artifact at weight_multiplier 1.0, and the policy supplies no de minimis tolerance; reading one in would be inventing a rule the policy does not contain. The close call is resolved by the strict-liability drafting against the charge. The driver is right that the rider did not appear and that POL-NS-04 does not exonerate her: the chat log holds a single driver message ('im at the pickup point', sent 18:34:07, read 18:34:37) and nothing from the rider, so limb (a) is not met, and the rider's device stayed 616.9–622.3 m from the pin (mean 619.4 m, rider_qualifying_fix_count 0), so limb (c) is affirmatively failed rather than merely undecidable. None of that changes the outcome: POL-NS-06 refunds the fee on the clock alone, expressly 'whether or not the rider was present'. EV-ADVIS-02741-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT). Both sides correctly agree that POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is therefore unavailable, so no separate in-geofence intervals can be summed and the single 179.0 s interval is the whole of the effective dwell. Because POL-NS-06 displaces POL-NS-01, POL-NS-07 does not operate: the $3.60 (80% of $4.50) shown in the fare derivation is not payable, the driver's request for a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling with amount_sgd mirroring $3.60 is rejected, and the rider funds nothing. The anti-farming check does not trip in any event — 1 no-show termination against 62 completed trips, a rate of 0.016, below both limbs — and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so no escalation arises under POL-NS-07 or POL-NS-09. The fare line reconciles to the platform figure: cancellation_fee and total_charged are both $4.50, equal to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08 limbs (a)–(d): the bundle is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 throughout, so the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 escalation floor is not approached. Outcome: FULL_REFUND of $4.50 to the rider; driver compensation null; no referrals. The monetary effect ($4.50) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00 and so executes automatically on issue. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04.
Draft 4 - parties' positions swapped
Outcome: the $4.50 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable. The facts both sides agree on. The driver accepted the trip at 18:24:02, tapped 'I'm Here' at 18:33:47, and cancelled at 18:36:46 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after which $4.50 was charged (EV-FARE-02741: cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED). The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; POL-NS-01(c) reads the figure from platform_policy, and the resolution_rule confirms the older 300 s minimum_dwell_sec table is not applied to a record that carries platform_policy). Why the fee does not stand. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only if all four limbs hold, and limb (c) measures the driver's hold from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the arrival tap. That fix is at 18:33:47 (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), and the trip was terminated at 18:36:46, giving an effective dwell of 179 seconds against the required 180 - a 1.0 s shortfall. Limb (d) fails on the same clock, since the cancellation fell one second before the required dwell elapsed at 18:36:47. POL-NS-06 then applies in terms: a dwell shorter than the free waiting period in force makes the fee not chargeable, refunded in full, with no driver compensation, whether or not the rider was present. The rider's claims are accepted. The POL-NS-06 shortfall claim (180 required, 179 measured, 1.0 s short) is the ground of this ruling; the limb (c) and limb (d) failures and the no-recomputation point under POL-NS-05 are accepted; the absence of a traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02741-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is correctly disclosed and means POL-NS-06(i) cannot sum intervals, though the trace shows only one in-geofence interval in any event; and no driver payout arises because POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not. The driver's claims. I accept that the driver arrived: 19 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius satisfy POL-NS-02, and that there was a single continuous in-geofence interval with no trace gap (gaps [], max_gap_sec 0.0, coverage 100%). Arrival is not the issue; the clock is. I also accept that the charged $4.50 reconciles exactly with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect exists, and that POL-NS-03 does not apply (the stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, not in the wrong-entrance band). I reject the driver's central argument that a 1-second margin below the trace's 10-second sampling interval cannot prove a shortfall. The dwell is not an estimate from sparse samples: both endpoints are exact recorded timestamps (first qualifying fix 18:33:47; cancellation 18:36:46), and the platform's own separate wait-timer telemetry shows the timer starting at 18:33:49 and the cancellation at 18:36:46, 177 seconds later. Two independent readings put the cancellation before the free period had run. The driver carries the burden of showing the charge condition was met (POL-GEN-07(1)-(2)), and the record does not show 180 seconds. For the same reason I reject the driver's $3.60 payout claim and the requested DRIVER_COMPENSATION outcome. The driver's claim that POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider is accepted (no rider message; rider track never within ~617 m of the pin), but the rider's absence does not excuse a short wait. The driver's statement that he 'waited the free period' is evidence like any other, but it is self-serving and is contradicted by the platform's own measurements, so it does not carry the deciding fact. No escalation. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (1 no-show termination in 30 days against 62 completed trips, 0.016 - both limbs below threshold); POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire (0 counterparty disputes, 0 rider no-show disputes in 30 days). The artifacts carrying the deciding fact, EV-GPS-02741 and EV-TRIP-02741, are both weight 1.0 and un impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d), so the confidence cap is 1.0 and the 0.70 floor is not approached. EV-ADVIS-02741-01 carries weight 0.0 (MISSING) and can carry no fact; its absence is cited only to show accumulation is unavailable and does not depress confidence (POL-GEN-02(3)). Execution. The monetary effect ($4.50) is below the $8.00 execution threshold, so under POL-GEN-05 this ruling executes automatically on issue. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days.
